description:
List where this company's events are delivered.

One row per endpoint: its id (what delete_webhook takes), URL,
events and whether it is active. Secrets are never returned.
Needs webhook:manage. Read-only.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

name: list_webhooks

WebhookEndpoint.description: One endpoint the company's events are delivered to. No secret.

events.description: The events sent there. Empty means every event.

outputSchema.description: The company's endpoints in the connection's environment.
